headline: Binance Attributes $6.34 Billion Cyberattack to North Korea
summary: Binance reported that its security team detected and prevented numerous North Korea-linked cyber threat cases, while digital asset markets faced broader pullbacks.
why: Major security incidents involving leading cryptocurrency exchanges can impact market sentiment, regulatory scrutiny, and token valuations across the digital asset sector.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Security breaches and shifting political trends weigh on cryptocurrency prices.
